facts.fact: The BCEAO says payment institutions are licensed under Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services in the UMOA, and counts 34 licensed in the Union at 31 August 2026.
facts.system: BCEAO Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services in the UMOA

facts.fact: The BCEAO list names two payment institutions licensed in Burkina Faso: INTOUCH Burkina (EP.BF.001/2025, 9 May 2025) and KERRY Payments Burkina (EP.BF.002/2025, 2 September 2025).
facts.system: BCEAO Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services in the UMOA
